rule: Within each band, rank the new skeleton slugs by sha256 of the slug, ascending. The first is test_reserve, the rest are train_val. Deterministic, computable before any prose exists, and independent of how any book turns out.
why: Assigning after drafting would let book quality influence which split it lands in, which is selection leakage into the acceptance set. The plan makes splits immutable (review-model-distillation-plan.md section 3); this is that rule, fixed in advance.
battery_unchanged: The six W7 battery books stay the battery. Swapping in new books now would move the acceptance bar mid-plan and break comparability with the W7 numbers measured on 2026-08-14. test_reserve books are held for a future battery refresh that is a deliberate, separate decision.
